# Third-party notices

The host also bundles @deepseek-ai/schemastery 3.18.5 and
@deepseek-ai/cosmokit 1.8.6 from DeepSeek Harness (MIT, Shigma).
Their original license texts are included in SCHEMASTERY-LICENSE.txt
and COSMOKIT-LICENSE.txt.

The client bundles thinking-orbs 0.3.1 (MIT, Jakub Antalik).
Its license is included in THINKING-ORBS-LICENSE.txt. React is provided
by the DSH host and is not bundled into the plugin.

The bundled host uses opencc-js 1.4.2 (https://github.com/nk2028/opencc-js),
including its OpenCC-derived dictionary data. Its package declares
`MIT AND Apache-2.0` licensing. The original license, data attribution notices,
and Apache 2.0 license text are included in `opencc-js/`.

The converter and dictionaries are bundled locally; conversion does not send
transcripts to an external service.
